reason: I already have my gummies routine and I'd rather ask my doctor which magnesium to take than pick a random one off TikTok. One form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule just looks like less to me.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? Made in China also makes me hesitate, even with the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me bisglycinate alone is what I need, or a clear explanation of why one form beats 8 forms.
